# New Skills Academy

> > New Skills Academy offers 700+ CPD-certified online courses across professional development, creative, technical, and vocational skills with flexible Unlimited Learning subscriptions.

New Skills Academy is a comprehensive online learning platform providing accredited professional development courses across 15+ subject categories. The platform emphasizes CPD certification, flexible subscription models, and accessible skill training for career advancement and personal development.

## Key Topics

- CPD-certified courses
- Online learning platform
- Unlimited Learning subscription
- Professional development
- Course catalog
- Skills training
- Career development
- Microsoft Excel
- Interview Skills and CV Writing
- Health & Safety
- Food Safety
- Beauty Therapy
- Business management
- Student testimonials
- Course bundles

## Core Platform

- [Online Courses & Qualifications](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk): New Skills Academy homepage showcasing 700+ CPD-certified online courses
- [All Online Courses](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses): Main course catalog with filtering, sorting, and Unlimited Learning subscription options
- [Unlimited Course Subscription](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/subscription): Unlimited Learning subscription pricing and membership benefits overview
- [Bundle Courses](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/mega-course): Course bundles with Unlimited Learning subscription and membership options

## Professional & Business Skills

- [Business](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/business): CPD-certified business courses covering management and professional development
- [Finance](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/finance): CPD-certified finance courses covering accounting and bookkeeping skills
- [Computing](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/computing): CPD-certified computing courses including Microsoft Office technology skills
- [Education](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/teaching): CPD-certified education courses for teacher training and safeguarding

## Health, Safety & Hospitality

- [Health & Safety](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/health-safety): CPD-certified health and safety courses for workplace risk assessment
- [Food Safety](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/food-safety): CPD-certified Level 4 food safety and hygiene courses for hospitality
- [Hospitality & Tourism](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/hospitality-tourism): CPD-certified hospitality courses for hotel, restaurant, and events management

## Creative & Personal Development

- [Beauty Therapy Courses](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/beauty): CPD-accredited beauty therapy courses for salon management and treatments
- [Fitness](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/fitness): CPD-certified fitness instructor training and exercise programs
- [Fashion & Design](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/fashion-design): CPD-certified fashion and design courses for interior and visual design
- [Entertainment](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/entertainment): CPD-certified entertainment courses for event, wedding, and party planning
- [Horticulture](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/horticulture): CPD-certified horticulture courses including floristry and gardening

## Specialized & Vocational Training

- [Animal Care Courses](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/animal-care): CPD-certified animal care courses including pet grooming and nutrition
- [Language](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/courses/language-school): Language courses in Spanish, French, Russian, Vietnamese, and more

## Support & Account Management

- [Support](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/support): Support hub with student testimonials, reviews, and contact assistance
- [Redeem A Voucher](https://newskillsacademy.co.uk/redeem): Voucher redemption page with course promotion and student testimonials
